fullDescription: A high-impact Neo-Brutalist landing page style featuring a bold yellow and charcoal palette, stark black borders, and hard shadows. This design system is ideal for high-stakes SaaS platforms, recruitment portals, educational tech, or defense-oriented services. It utilizes a combination of editorial-style typography (Cabinet Grotesk) and functional sans-serif body text (Satoshi) to create an authoritative yet modern aesthetic. Key features include asymmetric cards, scroll-triggered marquee text, bento-grid layouts, and interactive dashboard mockups with high-contrast color blocking.
prompt:
## Resumo
A Neo-Brutalist SaaS design system emphasizing geometric precision, high-contrast accessibility, and flat, shadow-heavy UI components. It avoids all gradients and soft blurs in favor of hard-edged shapes and raw CSS transformations.

## Estilo Visual
Apply a Neo-Brutalist aesthetic using a palette of Yellow (#ffe17c), Charcoal (#171e19), Sage (#b7c6c2), White (#ffffff), and Black (#000000). Typography: Headings in 'Cabinet Grotesk' (Extrabold, tracking-tighter), Body in 'Satoshi' (Medium). Styling rules: All containers must have a 2px solid black border. Use hard shadows: 'hard-shadow-sm' (4px 4px 0px 0px #000000) and 'hard-shadow-md' (8px 8px 0px 0px #000000). Buttons should have a hover state of 'transform: translate(2px, 2px)' with a corresponding decrease in shadow size. Backgrounds on yellow sections should feature a 32px radial dot pattern at 10% opacity. No gradients, no blur, and no rounded corners exceeding 12px except for specific pill-shaped badges.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Fixed Utility Header
Create an 80px high fixed header in #ffe17c. Left: Logo with a 10x10 black square and a yellow bolt icon. Center: Navigation links in bold uppercase Satoshi with 2px underline decoration on hover. Right: A black primary button with white text and an 8px hard shadow. Bottom-border: 2px solid black.

### Hero Section
Two-column grid on #ffe17c background with a 32px radial dot pattern. Left column: A white pill badge 'NEW: ...', an 8XL heading in Cabinet Grotesk (one keyword must be transparent with a 2px black stroke), and two large action buttons (one black, one white). Right column: A browser mockup with 12px hard shadow, three colored window control dots (#ff5f57, #febc2e, #28c840), and internal sage-colored data panels.

### Social Proof Marquee
A full-width marquee with #171e19 background. Text should be 4XL Cabinet Grotesk in #b7c6c2 at 50% opacity. Animation: Continuous smooth infinite horizontal scroll. Content: Organization names separated by middle dots (·).

### Problem vs Solution
A side-by-side card layout. Problem card: #f4f4f5 background, 2px dashed gray border, 70% opacity, red 'X' icons for list items. Solution card: #ffe17c background, 2px solid black border, 8px hard shadow, black square icons with yellow checkmarks for list items. Use 2rem border radius for both.

### Feature Grid
A 3-column grid of white cards on a yellow section. Each card: 2px border, 4px hard shadow. Includes a 16x16 icon box in #b7c6c2 that turns #ffe17c on hover. Headings should be text-2xl with medium-weight body text.

### The Mission Flow (Horizontal Steps)
Dark mode section (#171e19). Three horizontal steps connected by a dark gray line. Each step consists of a 24x24 circle with a colored glow border (Step 1: Sage glow, Step 2: Yellow glow, Step 3: White glow). Large step numbers (01, 02, 03) inside circles.

### Asymmetric Testimonials
A 3-column grid on #b7c6c2 background. Cards: White background, 2px border, 4px shadow. Unique shape: Top-Right and Bottom-Left corners 3xl rounded, Top-Left and Bottom-Right corners sharp (2px). Include 5-star rating in #ffbc2e.

### Utility Footer
Charcoal background (#171e19). 4-column layout including company info, product links, resources, and social. Social icons are 10x10 squares in #272727 with gray borders, turning yellow on hover. Use 10% opacity white text for the copyright notice.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Neo-Brutalist Primary Button — A high-tactility interactive button that mimics physical pressing.
Background: #000000; Color: #ffffff; Border: 2px solid #000000; Box-shadow: 8px 8px 0px 0px #000000; Padding: 1rem 2rem; Font: Satoshi Bold; Transition: 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275). Hover: transform: translate(4px, 4px); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px 0px #000000.

### Asymmetric Rounded Card — A card container with non-standard corner radii to break visual repetition.
Border: 2px solid black; background: #ffffff; border-top-right-radius: 1.875rem; border-bottom-left-radius: 1.875rem; border-top-left-radius: 2px; border-bottom-right-radius: 2px; padding: 2rem; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px 0px #000000;

### Glow-Step Indicators — Status indicators for dark backgrounds using colored outer glows instead of drop shadows.
Container: 96px circle; Background: #171e19; Border: 2px solid #000000; Variations: .glow-sage { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #b7c6c2; }, .glow-yellow { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #ffe17c; }, .glow-white { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #ffffff; }.

style.description: The style is defined by its raw, 'honest' Neo-Brutalist roots. Typography pairs the aggressive, variable-weight 'Cabinet Grotesk' for headlines with the clean 'Satoshi' for body copy. The color palette centers on 'Primary Yellow' (#ffe17c) for energy and 'Charcoal' (#171e19) for stability. Crucially, all interactive elements utilize 'Hard Shadows' (offset but 0 blur) and 2px solid black borders to create a tactile, comic-book-inspired physical presence.
